source_cases.label: SAME_STAGGER
source_cases.script: set x SAME; set log {}; after 0 {set x SAME; lappend log SAME}; after 10 {set x NEXT; lappend log NEXT}; vwait x; set log

source_cases.label: ARRAY_STAGGER
source_cases.script: array set a {k OLD}; after 0 {set a(k) OLD}; after 10 {set a(k) NEW}; vwait a(k); set a(k)

source_cases.label: BATCH_CANCEL
source_cases.script: set log {}; after 0 {lappend ::log FIRST; after cancel $::later}; set ::later [after 0 {lappend ::log SECOND}]; update; set log

source_cases.label: BATCH_NEW
source_cases.script: set log {}; after 0 {lappend ::log FIRST; after 0 {lappend ::log NEW}}; after 0 {lappend ::log SECOND}; update; set log

source_cases.label: GLOBAL_PREFIX_BGERROR
source_cases.script: set done 0; proc handler {prefix message options} {set ::done [list $prefix $message [dict get $options -code]]}; interp bgerror {} [list handler PRE]; after 0 {error BOOM}; vwait done; set done
